proposed_facts.reason: Canonical floor processing distinguishes failed contact from the supported-floor exceptional branch. The former invokes the state-1 selector; the latter dispatches EnteredAir, whose Parasol implementation selects state 3, before the engine writes x1F. The wrapper always returns false.

The state-7 wrapper forwards caller speed through animSpeed, requests sound 247, and uses ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE. The state changer resets the current frame and initializes animation/script state, supporting correction of the animation-preserving description.

The state-9 wrapper preserves object and speed arguments. The shared helper performs audio before speed assignment and state change; the canonical audio signature identifies sound ID, pan and volume, and its applicable branch stores the returned handle in xD6C.

Resolved the audio-mask claim: the three arguments are sound ID, pan and volume. Proposal fact 2 retains pointer flow and operation ordering.
